caption: An un-crimped Danfoss EZ Clip, a metallic band-style hose clamp, is displayed, featuring multiple tabs or interlocking points designed for mechanical fastening. No part numbers, labels, or explicit measurements are visible on the component itself. This image serves to clearly identify the correct EZ Clip component within the manual, assisting the user in proper part selection before installation or tool application.

This image illustrates a section of a Danfoss EZ Clip to 5400 Series hose assembly, depicting a fitting securely joined to a black hydraulic hose using three metal EZ Clips. The hose is clearly marked with the identification "GH001-12 W". Its purpose in the manual is to provide a visual standard for correctly assembled EZ Clip connections, helping users verify proper component integration and assembly technique.

This image illustrates the critical step of installing spring-type hose clamps onto a black hydraulic hose. Two "AK 86" clamps are shown being advanced, indicated by red arrows, towards a hose segment clearly labeled "GH 01-12 DN16," with "DN16" signifying a nominal diameter of 16mm. This visual guidance emphasizes the correct orientation and securing sequence for EZ Clip clamps during a Danfoss 5400 Series hose assembly, likely depicting the process of preparing the hose for a fitting.

Two specialized hand tools are shown, integral to Danfoss EZ Clip to 5400 Series hose assembly. The upper tool is a crimping pliers with distinct jaws designed for securing EZ Clips, bearing partially visible tool specifications (e.g., "DN") near its pivot. The lower tool is a black, composite-material cutting or preparation device, likely used for precise hose trimming or scoring, a crucial step before crimping.

This sheet provides a comprehensive collection of product identification labels for Danfoss EZ Clip series hose fittings, intended for use with 5400 Series hose assemblies. Each label presents a unique part number, such as FJ3052-1012S or FJ3055-02-0608S, a corresponding barcode, and a concise technical description detailing the fitting type (e.g., "Straight Female Cring") and configuration (e.g., "Std, 90 deg"). This image serves as a critical reference for accurate component identification, selection, and inventory management during the precise hose assembly process.

This image displays the Danfoss E-Z Clip Air Conditioning Hose Assembly System kit, contained within an open black carrying case with foam inserts. The kit includes various sizes of metal cages (P/N IF40105-XXC), clips (P/N IF40104-XXC), and a green-handled assembly plier tool (P/N 1257), along with a reference chart listing kit contents, specific cage and clip part numbers by sizes 12, 10, 8, and 6, and O-ring part numbers (e.g., 22546-17 for size 12). This technical illustration provides a visual inventory and component breakdown, indicating the necessary parts and tools for assembling Danfoss 5400 Series and GH134/Z6000 hoses.
